## Resumen Estructurado — Congreso BiSide 2026

**PREDICTORES CLÍNICOS Y COMORBILIDADES ASOCIADAS A DESENLACES HOSPITALARIOS EN PATOLOGÍA ENDOCRINO-METABÓLICA EN CHILE, 2019-2024**

**Introducción:** Las enfermedades endocrinas, nutricionales y metabólicas generan una carga hospitalaria creciente en Chile, con perfiles de mortalidad y estadía heterogéneos entre categorías diagnósticas. Identificar predictores pronósticos diferenciados, ajustando por la estructura jerárquica de los establecimientos, resulta esencial para optimizar la gestión clínica intrahospitalaria.

**Materiales y Métodos:** Estudio de cohorte retrospectiva sobre 128.052 egresos del sistema de Grupos Relacionados de Diagnóstico (GRD) de Chile (2019-2024), clasificados en diez categorías diagnósticas (CIE-10 E00-E89) y catorce grupos de comorbilidades derivadas de diagnósticos secundarios. Se ajustaron ecuaciones de estimación generalizadas (GEE) con agrupación por hospital y correlación intercambiable: enlace logit para mortalidad intrahospitalaria y enlace logarítmico con distribución binomial negativa para duración de estadía. La selección de comorbilidades se realizó mediante pruebas bivariadas independientes por categoría (p<0,05). Complementariamente, cinco algoritmos de clasificación fueron evaluados con seis técnicas de balanceo de clases y umbral optimizado por el índice J de Youden.

**Resultados:** Se registraron 2.748 defunciones (mortalidad global 2,15%). Obesidad (32,2%) y diabetes (28,1%) constituyeron las categorías más frecuentes. La mortalidad osciló entre 0,13% (obesidad) y 4,47% (trastornos de glucosa), con diabetes en 2,00%, desnutrición 3,79% y trastornos metabólicos 3,60%. La estadía media varió de 2,9 días (obesidad) a 16,5 días (deficiencias nutricionales). Las GEE alcanzaron AUC de 0,955 (tiroides) a 0,767 (nutricionales) para mortalidad, con edad, severidad y riesgo de mortalidad como predictores transversales consistentes. Las comorbilidades nutricionales incrementaron la estadía en +8,0 días y las cardiovasculares en +7,2 días. El aprendizaje automático con balanceo logró AUC de hasta 0,982 (obesidad) y 0,855 (desnutrición).

**Conclusiones:** La patología endocrino-metabólica presenta perfiles de riesgo marcadamente distintos por categoría, desde la baja letalidad de la obesidad hasta la elevada mortalidad de los trastornos glucémicos. El modelado GEE con estructura hospitalaria y selección específica de comorbilidades proporciona herramientas interpretables para la estratificación de riesgo clínico diferenciado.

**Palabras clave:** enfermedades endocrinas, mortalidad intrahospitalaria, ecuaciones de estimación generalizadas, comorbilidad, aprendizaje automático.

:::

## Structured Abstract — BiSide 2026 Congress

**CLINICAL PREDICTORS AND COMORBIDITIES ASSOCIATED WITH HOSPITAL OUTCOMES IN ENDOCRINE-METABOLIC PATHOLOGY IN CHILE, 2019-2024**

**Introduction:** Endocrine, nutritional, and metabolic diseases impose a growing hospital burden in Chile, with heterogeneous mortality and length-of-stay profiles across diagnostic categories. Identifying differentiated prognostic predictors while accounting for the hierarchical structure of healthcare facilities is essential for optimizing in-hospital clinical management.

**Materials and Methods:** Retrospective cohort study of 128,052 discharges from the Chilean Diagnosis-Related Groups (GRD) system (2019-2024), classified into ten diagnostic categories (ICD-10 E00-E89) and fourteen comorbidity groups derived from secondary diagnoses. Generalized estimating equations (GEE) were fitted with hospital clustering and exchangeable correlation: logit link for in-hospital mortality and log link with negative binomial distribution for length of stay. Comorbidity selection was performed through independent bivariate testing per category (p<0.05). Additionally, five classification algorithms were evaluated with six class balancing techniques and threshold optimized by Youden's J index.

**Results:** A total of 2,748 deaths were recorded (overall mortality 2.15%). Obesity (32.2%) and diabetes (28.1%) were the most frequent categories. Mortality ranged from 0.13% (obesity) to 4.47% (glucose disorders), with diabetes at 2.00%, malnutrition 3.79%, and metabolic disorders 3.60%. Mean length of stay varied from 2.9 days (obesity) to 16.5 days (nutritional deficiencies). GEE achieved AUC from 0.955 (thyroid) to 0.767 (nutritional) for mortality, with age, severity, and mortality risk as consistent cross-cutting predictors. Nutritional comorbidities increased stay by +8.0 days and cardiovascular comorbidities by +7.2 days. Machine learning with class balancing achieved AUC up to 0.982 (obesity) and 0.855 (malnutrition).

**Conclusions:** Endocrine-metabolic pathology exhibits markedly distinct risk profiles by category, from the low lethality of obesity to the elevated mortality of glucose disorders. GEE modeling with hospital structure and category-specific comorbidity selection provides interpretable tools for differentiated clinical risk stratification.

**Keywords:** endocrine diseases, in-hospital mortality, generalized estimating equations, comorbidity, machine learning.

:::

# Methods

## 1.1 Study Design and Data Source

This is a retrospective cohort study using GRD (Grupo Relacionado de Diagnóstico) public hospital discharge data from the Chilean Ministry of Health (MINSAL) for the years 2019–2024. The GRD database captures all hospitalizations in public hospitals and contains 35 diagnostic fields (DIAGNOSTICO1 through DIAGNOSTICO35), administrative variables, and clinical indicators including severity (IR_29301_SEVERIDAD: coded 1–3 as Low, Medium, High) and mortality risk (IR_29301_MORTALIDAD: coded 1–3 as Low, Medium, High). Additional variables include patient dates of birth and admission/discharge, sex, and service of admission.

## 1.2 Case Identification

Cases were identified through the primary diagnosis (DIAGNOSTICO1) field using ICD-10 codes E00–E89 (Endocrine, nutritional and metabolic diseases). Cases were classified into 10 disease categories based on anatomical and functional groupings:

- **E00–E07**: Thyroid disorders
- **E08–E13**: Diabetes mellitus (including drug-induced and secondary forms)
- **E15–E16**: Other disorders of glucose regulation
- **E20–E35**: Disorders of other endocrine glands (parathyroid, pituitary, adrenal, etc.)
- **E36**: Intraoperative complications of endocrine procedures
- **E40–E46**: Malnutrition and nutritional deficiencies
- **E50–E64**: Other nutritional deficiency disorders
- **E65–E68**: Obesity and hyperalimentation
- **E70–E88**: Metabolic disorders (amino acid, lipid, carbohydrate metabolism)
- **E89**: Postprocedural endocrine and metabolic complications

## 1.3 Lifestyle-Related Comorbidity Classification

Comorbidities were identified from secondary diagnoses (DIAGNOSTICO2 through DIAGNOSTICO35) using ICD-10 codes and grouped into 14 lifestyle-related categories:

1. **Obesity/Overweight**: E65, E66, E67, E68, R63, Z68
2. **Dyslipidemia/Metabolic**: E78, E79, E88
3. **Diabetes/Glucose disorders**: E08, E09, E10, E11, E12, E13, E14, R73
4. **Hypertension**: I10, I11, I12, I13, I15, I16, I27
5. **Tobacco-related**: F17, Z72, Z87, J40, J41, J42, J43, J44, J47, J98
6. **Alcohol-related**: F10, K70, K29, G31, G62, G72, I42, K86, E24, E52, T51, Y90, Y91
7. **Substance use**: F11, F12, F13, F14, F15, F16, F18, F19, F55
8. **Nutritional deficiencies**: E40, E41, E42, E43, E44, E45, E46, E50, E51, E52, E53, E54, E55, E56, E58, E59, E60, E61, E63, E64, D50, D51, D52, D53
9. **Liver disease (non-alcoholic)**: K72, K73, K74, K75, K76, K77
10. **Sleep disorders**: G47, F51, G25
11. **Cardiovascular disease**: I20, I21, I22, I23, I24, I25, I50, I51, I64, I65, I66, I67, I70, I73, I77, I78
12. **Gastrointestinal disease**: K21, K22, K25, K26, K27, K28, K29, K30, K31, K58, K59, K90, K91, K92
13. **Musculoskeletal/Sedentary**: M25, M54, M62, M79, M80, M81, M85
14. **Mental health/Lifestyle**: F32, F33, F34, F41, F43, F48, F50, F54

For each patient, a binary indicator $I_j$ denotes presence of comorbidity $j$, and total comorbidity burden is defined as:
$$N_{\text{comorbidities}} = \sum_{j=1}^{14} I_j$$

## 1.4 Statistical Analyses

### 1.4.1 Descriptive Statistics

Descriptive statistics were computed for age, sex, mortality, length of stay (LOS), and comorbidity burden. Categorical variables are presented as frequencies and percentages; continuous variables are presented with mean, standard deviation, median, and range. Mortality rate (in-hospital death) is presented as percentage. LOS is presented as mean, median, and interquartile range.

### 1.4.2 Bivariate Associations

Chi-square tests were performed to assess associations between categorical variables and mortality:
$$\chi^2 = \sum_{i,j} \frac{(O_{ij} - E_{ij})^2}{E_{ij}}$$

where $O_{ij}$ is the observed frequency and $E_{ij}$ is the expected frequency under independence. Fisher's exact test was used when expected cell frequencies were less than 5. Wilcoxon rank-sum test was used to compare LOS between groups:
$$W = \sum_{i=1}^{n_1} R_i$$

where $R_i$ are ranks assigned to observations from the first group.

### 1.4.3 Mixed-Effects Logistic Regression for Mortality

A mixed-effects logistic regression model was fitted to examine associations between comorbidities and mortality, with year as a random effect:
$$\log\left(\frac{\pi_{ij}}{1-\pi_{ij}}\right) = \beta_0 + \mathbf{x}_{ij}^T\boldsymbol{\beta} + u_j$$

where $\pi_{ij}$ is the probability of mortality for individual $i$ in year $j$, $\mathbf{x}_{ij}$ are fixed covariates, $\boldsymbol{\beta}$ are fixed effect coefficients, and $u_j \sim N(0, \sigma^2_u)$ is the random year effect. Only comorbidities significant in bivariate analysis ($p < 0.05$) were included in the model. In Python, this was approximated using Generalized Estimating Equations (GEE) with logit link function and exchangeable correlation structure, with year as the grouping variable. Results are presented as Odds Ratios (OR) with 95% confidence intervals (CI).

### 1.4.4 Negative Binomial Mixed Models for Length of Stay

LOS was modeled using a negative binomial mixed regression model with year as a random effect:
$$\log(\mu_{ij}) = \beta_0 + \mathbf{x}_{ij}^T\boldsymbol{\beta} + u_j$$
$$Y_{ij} \sim \text{NB}(\mu_{ij}, \theta)$$

where $Y_{ij}$ is the LOS for individual $i$ in year $j$, $\mu_{ij}$ is the expected count, $\theta$ is the dispersion parameter, and variance = $\mu + \mu^2/\theta$. In Python, Negative Binomial regression was fitted with year as categorical predictor using statsmodels. Results are presented as Incidence Rate Ratios (IRR) with 95% CI.

### 1.4.5 Model Performance Assessment

Model performance was assessed using the following metrics:

**Area Under the Receiver Operating Characteristic Curve (AUC)**:
$$\text{AUC} = P(S_1 > S_0)$$

where $S_1$ and $S_0$ are predicted probabilities for positive and negative cases, respectively.

**Hosmer-Lemeshow Goodness of Fit Test**:
$$C = \sum_{g=1}^{10} \frac{(O_g - E_g)^2}{E_g(1 - E_g/n_g)}$$

where $O_g$ and $E_g$ are observed and expected frequencies in decile $g$.

### 1.4.6 Pseudo-R² Measures

Multiple pseudo-$R^2$ measures were computed:

**McFadden's $R^2$**:
$$R^2_{\text{McFadden}} = 1 - \frac{\log L_{\text{full}}}{\log L_{\text{null}}}$$

**Cox-Snell $R^2$**:
$$R^2_{\text{Cox-Snell}} = 1 - \left(\frac{L_{\text{null}}}{L_{\text{full}}}\right)^{2/n}$$

**Nagelkerke $R^2$**:
$$R^2_{\text{Nagelkerke}} = \frac{R^2_{\text{Cox-Snell}}}{1 - L_{\text{null}}^{2/n}}$$

### 1.4.7 Additional Classification Metrics

**Sensitivity** (True Positive Rate):
$$\text{Se} = \frac{TP}{TP + FN}$$

**Specificity** (True Negative Rate):
$$\text{Sp} = \frac{TN}{TN + FP}$$

**Positive Predictive Value**:
$$\text{PPV} = \frac{TP}{TP + FP}$$

**Negative Predictive Value**:
$$\text{NPV} = \frac{TN}{TN + FN}$$

**F1 Score**:
$$F_1 = 2 \times \frac{\text{Precision} \times \text{Recall}}{\text{Precision} + \text{Recall}}$$

**Matthews Correlation Coefficient**:
$$\text{MCC} = \frac{TP \cdot TN - FP \cdot FN}{\sqrt{(TP+FP)(TP+FN)(TN+FP)(TN+FN)}}$$

**Brier Score**:
$$\text{BS} = \frac{1}{n}\sum_{i=1}^{n}(p_i - o_i)^2$$

where $p_i$ is predicted probability and $o_i$ is observed outcome.

For length of stay regression models: Root Mean Squared Error (RMSE), Mean Absolute Error (MAE), and R² were computed.

### 1.4.8 Sensitivity Analyses

Youden's index was calculated to determine optimal threshold for binary classification:
$$J = \max(\text{Se} + \text{Sp} - 1)$$

Machine learning models were evaluated using 80/20 stratified train-test split with feature standardization.

```{python}
def format_name(name):
    """Format variable name for display"""
    if name in DISPLAY_NAMES:
        return DISPLAY_NAMES[name]
    # Handle year dummies like 'year_2020'
    if name.startswith('year_'):
        year_val = name.split('_')[1]
        return f'Year {year_val}'
    # Handle C() statsmodels names
    if name.startswith('C('):
        formatted = name.replace('C(', '').replace(')', '').replace('[T.', ': ').replace(']', '')
        return formatted
    # Generic cleanup
    return name.replace('_', ' ').title()
```

```{python}
# Función para normalizar fechas (maneja formatos diferentes)
def parse_date_flexible(date_str, year=None):
    """
    Parsea fechas que pueden estar en formato DD-MM-YYYY o YYYY-MM-DD
    """
    if pd.isna(date_str) or date_str == '':
        return pd.NaT

    if isinstance(date_str, (int, float)):
        return pd.NaT

    date_str = str(date_str).strip()

    # Para 2023: DD-MM-YYYY; para otros: YYYY-MM-DD
    if year == 2023:
        for fmt in ["%d-%m-%Y", "%Y-%m-%d", "%d/%m/%Y", "%Y/%m/%d"]:
            try:
                return pd.to_datetime(date_str, format=fmt)
            except:
                continue
    else:
        for fmt in ["%Y-%m-%d", "%d-%m-%Y", "%Y/%m/%d", "%d/%m/%Y"]:
            try:
                return pd.to_datetime(date_str, format=fmt)
            except:
                continue

    return pd.NaT

# Aplicar normalización de fechas
date_cols = ['FECHA_NACIMIENTO', 'FECHA_INGRESO', 'FECHAALTA']

for col in date_cols:
    if col in df_grd.columns:
        df_grd[col] = df_grd.apply(
            lambda row: parse_date_flexible(row[col], row.get('year')),
            axis=1
        )
```

```{python}
# Función para clasificar enfermedades endocrinas
def get_endocrine_category(diag_str):
    """Clasifica diagnóstico en categoría de enfermedad endocrina"""
    if pd.isna(diag_str) or diag_str == '':
        return None

    diag = str(diag_str).strip().upper()[:3]

    try:
        num = int(diag[1:])
        if 0 <= num <= 7:
            return 'E00-E07: Thyroid'
        elif 8 <= num <= 13:
            return 'E08-E13: Diabetes'
        elif 15 <= num <= 16:
            return 'E15-E16: Glucose'
        elif 20 <= num <= 35:
            return 'E20-E35: Endocrine'
        elif num == 36:
            return 'E36: Intraoperative'
        elif 40 <= num <= 46:
            return 'E40-E46: Malnutrition'
        elif 50 <= num <= 64:
            return 'E50-E64: Nutritional'
        elif 65 <= num <= 68:
            return 'E65-E68: Obesity'
        elif 70 <= num <= 88:
            return 'E70-E88: Metabolic'
        elif num == 89:
            return 'E89: Postprocedural'
    except:
        pass

    return None

# Filtrar registros válidos
# Remover sexo desconocido
df_clean = df_grd[df_grd['SEXO'] != 'DESCONOCIDO'].copy()

# Remover edades faltantes o inválidas
df_clean = df_clean[(df_clean['age'].notna()) & (df_clean['age'] > 0) & (df_clean['age'] < 150)].copy()

# Remover duración de estadía inválida
df_clean = df_clean[(df_clean['length_of_stay'].notna()) & (df_clean['length_of_stay'] >= 0)].copy()
```

```{python}
# Filter for ENDOCRINE diseases (DIAGNOSTICO1 starting with E00-E89)
def is_endocrine_diagnosis(diag):
    """Checks if diagnosis is an endocrine disease (E00-E89)"""
    if pd.isna(diag) or diag == '':
        return False

    diag_str = str(diag).strip().upper()
    if len(diag_str) < 1:
        return False

    icd_code = diag_str[:3]

    if icd_code[0] == 'E':
        try:
            num = int(icd_code[1:])
            return 0 <= num <= 89
        except:
            return False

    return False

# Apply filter
df_endocrinas = df_clean[df_clean['DIAGNOSTICO1'].apply(is_endocrine_diagnosis)].copy()

# Classify by category
df_endocrinas['endocrine_category'] = df_endocrinas['DIAGNOSTICO1'].apply(get_endocrine_category)

vc = df_endocrinas['endocrine_category'].value_counts().reset_index()
vc.columns = ['Category', 'N']
vc['%'] = (vc['N'] / vc['N'].sum() * 100).round(1)
show_table(vc, "Endocrine Disease Category Distribution")
```

```{python}
    "tobacco_related": ["F17", "Z72", "Z87", "J44", "J43", "J41", "J42", "J47", "J40", "J98"],
    "alcohol_related": ["F10", "K70", "K29", "G31", "G62", "G72", "I42", "K86", "E24", "E52", "T51", "Y90", "Y91"],
    "substance_use": ["F11", "F12", "F13", "F14", "F15", "F16", "F18", "F19", "F55"],
    "nutritional_deficiencies": ["E40", "E41", "E42", "E43", "E44", "E45", "E46", "E50", "E51", "E52", "E53", "E54", "E55", "E56", "E58", "E59", "E60", "E61", "E63", "E64", "D50", "D51", "D52", "D53"],
    "liver_disease_nonalcoholic": ["K76", "K72", "K73", "K74", "K75", "K77"],
    "sleep_disorders": ["G47", "F51", "G25"],
    "cardiovascular": ["I20", "I21", "I22", "I23", "I24", "I25", "I50", "I51", "I64", "I65", "I66", "I67", "I70", "I73", "I77", "I78"],
    "gastrointestinal": ["K21", "K22", "K25", "K26", "K27", "K28", "K29", "K30", "K31", "K58", "K59", "K90", "K91", "K92"],
    "musculoskeletal": ["M79", "M81", "M80", "M85", "M62", "M25", "M54"],
    "mental_health": ["F32", "F33", "F34", "F41", "F43", "F48", "F50", "F54"]
}

def check_comorbidity_group(row, icd_prefixes):
    """Verifica si el paciente tiene algún diagnóstico en la lista de prefijos ICD"""
    for i in range(2, 36):
        col = f'DIAGNOSTICO{i}'
        if col in row.index and pd.notna(row[col]):
            diag = str(row[col]).strip().upper()[:3]
            for prefix in icd_prefixes:
                if diag.startswith(prefix):
                    return 1
    return 0

# Identificar comorbilidades
for group_name, icd_codes in life_groups.items():
    df_endocrinas[f'comor_{group_name}'] = df_endocrinas.apply(
        lambda row: check_comorbidity_group(row, icd_codes),
        axis=1
    )

# Comorbidity statistics
comor_cols = [col for col in df_endocrinas.columns if col.startswith('comor_')]
comor_summary = df_endocrinas[comor_cols].sum()
comor_summary.index = [col.replace('comor_', '') for col in comor_cols]
comor_pct = 100 * comor_summary / len(df_endocrinas)

# Display comorbidity prevalence
comor_display = pd.DataFrame({
    'Comorbidity': sorted(comor_summary.index),
    'Count': [comor_summary[name] for name in sorted(comor_summary.index)],
    'Percentage': [comor_pct[name] for name in sorted(comor_summary.index)]
})
comor_display.columns = [format_name(c) if c != 'Comorbidity' else c for c in comor_display.columns]
show_table(comor_display, "Comorbidity Prevalence Overview")

# Total comorbidity burden
df_endocrinas['total_comorbidities'] = df_endocrinas[comor_cols].sum(axis=1)

# Display comorbidity burden summary
comorbidity_burden = pd.DataFrame({
    'Metric': ['Mean', 'Median', 'Std Dev'],
    'Value': [
        f"{df_endocrinas['total_comorbidities'].mean():.2f}",
        f"{df_endocrinas['total_comorbidities'].median():.0f}",
        f"{df_endocrinas['total_comorbidities'].std():.2f}"
    ]
})
show_table(comorbidity_burden, "Comorbidity Burden Statistics")
```

```{python}
# Service categorization
def categorize_service(service_name):
    """Categorizes services into ICU/ITU, Medical/Surgical (MS), Others"""
    if pd.isna(service_name) or service_name == '':
        return 'Other'

    service = str(service_name).upper()

    if any(x in service for x in ['UCI', 'UTI', 'ICU', 'CRÍTICO', 'INTENSIVO', 'PABELLON CRITICO']):
        return 'ICU/ITU'
    elif any(x in service for x in ['CIRUGIA', 'MEDICINA', 'GENERAL']):
        return 'Medical/Surgical'
    else:
        return 'Other'

df_endocrinas['service_category'] = df_endocrinas['SERVICIOINGRESO'].apply(categorize_service)

vc_service = df_endocrinas['service_category'].value_counts().reset_index()
vc_service.columns = ['Service', 'N']
vc_service['%'] = (vc_service['N'] / vc_service['N'].sum() * 100).round(1)
show_table(vc_service, "Service Category Distribution")

# Severity and mortality risk
sev_cols = [col for col in df_endocrinas.columns if 'SEVERIDAD' in col.upper()]
if sev_cols:
    vc_sev = df_endocrinas[sev_cols[0]].value_counts().reset_index()
    vc_sev.columns = ['Severity', 'N']
    vc_sev['%'] = (vc_sev['N'] / vc_sev['N'].sum() * 100).round(1)
    show_table(vc_sev, "Severity Distribution")

mort_cols = [col for col in df_endocrinas.columns if 'MORTALIDAD' in col.upper()]
if mort_cols:
    vc_mort = df_endocrinas[mort_cols[0]].value_counts().reset_index()
    vc_mort.columns = ['Mortality Risk', 'N']
    vc_mort['%'] = (vc_mort['N'] / vc_mort['N'].sum() * 100).round(1)
    show_table(vc_mort, "Mortality Risk Distribution")
```

```{python}
                    _, p = fisher_exact([[contingency.iloc[0,0], contingency.iloc[0,1]],
                                         [contingency.iloc[1,0], contingency.iloc[1,1]]])
                except:
                    p = np.nan

        mortality_without = df_endocrinas[df_endocrinas[col] == 0]['mortality'].mean() * 100

                sig_star = '**'
```

```{python}
from scipy.stats import chi2_contingency, ranksums

# Bivariate analysis: chi-square for mortality, Wilcoxon for LOS per disease category
all_categories = sorted(df_endocrinas['endocrine_category'].dropna().unique())

for cat in all_categories:

        df_bivariate.append({

            'Comorbidity': format_name(col),
```

# 6. GEE Mixed-Effects Logistic Regression for Mortality (All Disease Categories)

```{python}
from statsmodels.genmod.generalized_estimating_equations import GEE
from statsmodels.genmod.families import Binomial, Poisson, NegativeBinomial
from statsmodels.genmod.cov_struct import Exchangeable, Independence
import statsmodels.api as sm

# Prepare hospital clustering variable
if 'COD_HOSPITAL' in df_endocrinas.columns:
    df_endocrinas['hospital_id'] = df_endocrinas['COD_HOSPITAL'].astype(str)
elif 'COD_HOSPITAL' in df_grd.columns:
    df_endocrinas['hospital_id'] = df_grd.loc[df_endocrinas.index, 'COD_HOSPITAL'].astype(str)
else:
    df_endocrinas['hospital_id'] = '1'

df_endocrinas['year_factor'] = df_endocrinas['year'].astype(str)

# Store GEE model results
gee_mortality_models = {}
gee_mortality_results = {}

def find_optimal_threshold(y_true, y_proba):
    """Find optimal classification threshold using Youden's J statistic"""
    fpr, tpr, thresholds = roc_curve(y_true, y_proba)
    j_scores = tpr - fpr
    best_idx = np.argmax(j_scores)
    return thresholds[best_idx]

def safe_fmt(val, fmt='.4f'):
    """Format a value safely, returning '—' for NaN/Inf"""
    if isinstance(val, float) and (np.isnan(val) or np.isinf(val)):
        return '—'
    try:
        return f'{val:{fmt}}'
    except:
        return '—'

def build_gee_mortality_model(df_cat, cat_name):
    """Build GEE logistic regression for mortality.
    Uses hospital_id as cluster group, year_factor as fixed effect,
    and only significant comorbidities from bivariate analysis."""
    df_model = df_cat.copy()

    # Create service dummies
    service_dummies = pd.get_dummies(df_model['service_category'], prefix='service', drop_first=True)
    for col in service_dummies.columns:
        df_model[col] = service_dummies[col]
    service_dummy_cols = list(service_dummies.columns)

    # Create year dummies (year_factor as fixed effect)
    year_dummies = pd.get_dummies(df_model['year_factor'], prefix='year', drop_first=True)
    for col in year_dummies.columns:
        df_model[col] = year_dummies[col]
    year_dummy_cols = list(year_dummies.columns)

    df_model['age'] = pd.to_numeric(df_model['age'], errors='coerce')

    # Base predictors
    predictor_cols = ['age', 'male'] + service_dummy_cols + year_dummy_cols

    # Add severity and mortality risk as categorical dummies
    for col in ['IR_29301_SEVERIDAD', 'IR_29301_MORTALIDAD']:
        if col in df_model.columns:
            df_model[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_model[col], errors='coerce')
            df_model[col] = df_model[col].fillna(1)
            df_model[col] = df_model[col].clip(lower=1).astype(int)
            prefix = 'severity' if 'SEVERIDAD' in col else 'mort_risk'
            col_dummies = pd.get_dummies(df_model[col], prefix=prefix, drop_first=True)
            for dc in col_dummies.columns:
                df_model[dc] = col_dummies[dc]
                predictor_cols.append(dc)

    # Add ONLY significant comorbidities from bivariate analysis
    sig_comorbs = sig_comorbidities_mortality.get(cat_name, [])
    used_comorbs = []
    for col in sig_comorbs:
        if col in df_model.columns:
            df_model[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_model[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
            if df_model[col].sum() >= 3:
                predictor_cols.append(col)
                used_comorbs.append(col)

    df_model['_group'] = df_model['hospital_id']

    cols_for_model = ['mortality', '_group'] + predictor_cols
    df_gee = df_model[cols_for_model].dropna()

    n_clusters = df_gee['_group'].nunique()
    if len(df_gee) < 50 or n_clusters < 2:
        return None, None, [], []

    y = df_gee['mortality'].astype(float)
    X = df_gee[predictor_cols].astype(float)
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    groups = df_gee['_group']

    try:
        gee_model = GEE(y, X, groups=groups, family=Binomial(), cov_struct=Exchangeable())
        gee_result = gee_model.fit(maxiter=200)
    except Exception:
        try:
            gee_model = GEE(y, X, groups=groups, family=Binomial(), cov_struct=Independence())
            gee_result = gee_model.fit(maxiter=200)
        except Exception:
            return None, None, [], []

    # Remove problematic variables
    max_retries = 5
    current_predictors = list(predictor_cols)
    for _ in range(max_retries):
        params = gee_result.params
        bad_vars = []
        for i, var in enumerate(current_predictors):
            idx = i + 1
            if idx < len(params) and (np.isinf(params.iloc[idx]) or abs(params.iloc[idx]) > 50):
                bad_vars.append(var)
        if not bad_vars:
            break
        current_predictors = [p for p in current_predictors if p not in bad_vars]
        if len(current_predictors) < 2:
            return None, None, [], []
        X = df_gee[current_predictors].astype(float)
        X = sm.add_constant(X)
        try:
            gee_model = GEE(y, X, groups=groups, family=Binomial(), cov_struct=Exchangeable())
            gee_result = gee_model.fit(maxiter=200)
        except:
            try:
                gee_model = GEE(y, X, groups=groups, family=Binomial(), cov_struct=Independence())
                gee_result = gee_model.fit(maxiter=200)
            except:
                return None, None, [], []

    return gee_result, df_gee, current_predictors, used_comorbs

def get_gee_fit_metrics(gee_result, y, family_type='binomial'):
    """Extract model fit metrics from a GEE result object."""
    metrics = {}
    metrics['N_obs'] = int(gee_result.nobs)
    metrics['N_clusters'] = int(len(set(gee_result.model.groups)))
    metrics['N_params'] = int(len(gee_result.params))

    try:
        qic, qicu = gee_result.qic()
        metrics['QIC'] = qic
        metrics['QICu'] = qicu
    except Exception:
        metrics['QIC'] = np.nan
        metrics['QICu'] = np.nan

    try:
        metrics['Scale'] = float(gee_result.scale)
    except Exception:
        metrics['Scale'] = np.nan

    try:
        y_pred = gee_result.fittedvalues
        if family_type == 'binomial':
            y_arr = np.asarray(y, dtype=float)
            p_hat = np.clip(np.asarray(y_pred, dtype=float), 1e-10, 1 - 1e-10)
            ll_model = np.sum(y_arr * np.log(p_hat) + (1 - y_arr) * np.log(1 - p_hat))
            p_null = np.mean(y_arr)
            ll_null = np.sum(y_arr * np.log(p_null) + (1 - y_arr) * np.log(1 - p_null))
            metrics['Log-Lik (model)'] = ll_model
            metrics['Log-Lik (null)'] = ll_null
            metrics['Pseudo R² (McFadden)'] = 1 - ll_model / ll_null if ll_null != 0 else np.nan
        else:
            y_arr = np.asarray(y, dtype=float)
            y_pred_arr = np.asarray(y_pred, dtype=float)
            ss_res = np.sum((y_arr - y_pred_arr) ** 2)
            ss_tot = np.sum((y_arr - np.mean(y_arr)) ** 2)
            metrics['Pseudo R²'] = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot if ss_tot > 0 else np.nan
    except Exception:
        if family_type == 'binomial':
            metrics['Log-Lik (model)'] = np.nan
            metrics['Log-Lik (null)'] = np.nan
            metrics['Pseudo R² (McFadden)'] = np.nan
        else:
            metrics['Pseudo R²'] = np.nan

    try:
        metrics['Correlation'] = gee_result.cov_struct.__class__.__name__
    except Exception:
        metrics['Correlation'] = '—'

    return metrics

# Fit GEE mortality models for EACH disease category
for cat in all_categories:
    df_cat = df_endocrinas[df_endocrinas['endocrine_category'] == cat].copy()

    n_events = df_cat['mortality'].sum()
    n_total = len(df_cat)
    if n_events < 10 or n_total < 50:
        continue

    gee_result, df_gee, used_cols, used_comorbs = build_gee_mortality_model(df_cat, cat)

    if gee_result is not None:
        gee_mortality_models[cat] = (gee_result, df_gee, used_cols)
        gee_mortality_results[cat] = gee_result
```

## 6.1 GEE Logistic Regression Results - OR [95% CI]

```{python}
# Table: GEE Logistic Regression - OR [95% CI] by Disease Category
gee_or_table = {}

for cat in all_categories:
    if cat not in gee_mortality_results:
        continue

    result = gee_mortality_results[cat]
    used_cols = gee_mortality_models[cat][2]

    params = result.params
    conf = result.conf_int()
    pvalues = result.pvalues

    col_data = {}
    for i, var in enumerate(used_cols):
        idx = i + 1  # skip constant
        if idx >= len(params):
            continue
        coef = params.iloc[idx]
        if np.isinf(coef) or abs(coef) > 50:
            continue
        or_val = np.exp(coef)
        ci_low = np.exp(conf.iloc[idx, 0])
        ci_high = np.exp(conf.iloc[idx, 1])
        pval = pvalues.iloc[idx]

        if np.isnan(or_val) or np.isnan(pval):
            continue

        sig = '***' if pval < 0.001 else '**' if pval < 0.01 else '*' if pval < 0.05 else ''
        col_data[format_name(var)] = f'{or_val:.3f} [{ci_low:.3f}, {ci_high:.3f}]{sig}'

    gee_or_table[cat] = col_data

if gee_or_table:
    all_vars = set()
    for col_data in gee_or_table.values():
        all_vars.update(col_data.keys())

    or_rows = []
    for var in sorted(all_vars):
        row = {'Variable': var}
        for cat in sorted(gee_or_table.keys()):
            row[cat] = gee_or_table[cat].get(var, '—')
        or_rows.append(row)

    gee_or_df = pd.DataFrame(or_rows).set_index('Variable')
    show_table(gee_or_df, "Table 9: GEE Mixed-Effects Logistic Regression - Odds Ratios [95% CI] for In-Hospital Mortality by Disease Category\n(Hospital as cluster, year as fixed effect, only significant comorbidities from bivariate analysis)\n* p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001", index=True)
```

**Forest plot — Odds Ratios (OR) [95% CI] for in-hospital mortality, by disease category.**

```{python}
#| label: fig-forest-gee-or-mortality
#| fig-cap: "Figure 8a. Forest plot of Odds Ratios [95% CI] from GEE logistic regression for in-hospital mortality, one panel per disease category. Vertical reference line at OR = 1 (log scale); estimates with p < 0.05 are highlighted in red."

from matplotlib.lines import Line2D

def plot_gee_forest(results_dict, ordered_keys, effect_label, sup_title, save_path,
                    sig_color='#c0392b', ns_color='#95a5a6'):
    """Forest plot of exp(coef) [95% CI] for each GEE model (one panel per group)."""
    panels = []
    for key in ordered_keys:
        res = results_dict.get(key)
        if res is None:
            continue
        params = res.params
        try:
            conf = res.conf_int()
        except Exception:
            continue
        pvals = res.pvalues
        lo_col, hi_col = conf.columns[0], conf.columns[1]
        rows = []
        for var in params.index:
            if str(var).lower() in ('const', 'intercept'):
                continue
            coef = params[var]
            if not np.isfinite(coef) or abs(coef) > 50:
                continue
            try:
                lo, hi = conf.loc[var, lo_col], conf.loc[var, hi_col]
            except Exception:
                continue
            if not (np.isfinite(lo) and np.isfinite(hi)):
                continue
            pval = float(pvals[var]) if var in pvals.index else np.nan
            rows.append((format_name(var), np.exp(coef), np.exp(lo), np.exp(hi), pval))
        if rows:
            rows.sort(key=lambda r: r[1])
            panels.append((key, rows))
    if not panels:
        print('No estimable models available to plot.')
        return
    n = len(panels)
    ncols = 2 if n > 1 else 1
    nrows = int(np.ceil(n / ncols))
    max_rows = max(len(r) for _, r in panels)
    fig_w = 7.5 * ncols
    fig_h = min(18, nrows * (0.30 * max_rows + 1.2))
    fig, axes = plt.subplots(nrows, ncols, figsize=(fig_w, fig_h), squeeze=False)
    axes_flat = axes.flatten()
    for ax_i, (key, rows) in enumerate(panels):
        ax = axes_flat[ax_i]
        labels = [r[0] for r in rows]
        ests = np.array([r[1] for r in rows])
        los = np.array([r[2] for r in rows])
        his = np.array([r[3] for r in rows])
        pvs = [r[4] for r in rows]
        for yi, (e, lo, hi, pv) in enumerate(zip(ests, los, his, pvs)):
            c = sig_color if (np.isfinite(pv) and pv < 0.05) else ns_color
            ax.plot([lo, hi], [yi, yi], color=c, lw=1.8, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=2)
            ax.plot([e], [yi], 'o', color=c, ms=6, zorder=3)
        ax.axvline(1.0, color='black', ls='--', lw=1.0, alpha=0.7, zorder=1)
        ax.set_yticks(range(len(rows)))
        ax.set_yticklabels(labels, fontsize=8)
        ax.set_ylim(-0.6, len(rows) - 0.4)
        ax.set_xscale('log')
        fin_lo = los[np.isfinite(los) & (los > 0)]
        fin_hi = his[np.isfinite(his) & (his > 0)]
        if len(fin_lo) and len(fin_hi):
            xlo, xhi = max(fin_lo.min() * 0.7, 1e-2), min(fin_hi.max() * 1.5, 1e3)
            if xlo < xhi:
                ax.set_xlim(xlo, xhi)
        ax.set_title(str(key), fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
        ax.set_xlabel(effect_label, fontsize=9)
        ax.grid(True, axis='x', alpha=0.3)
    for j in range(len(panels), len(axes_flat)):
        axes_flat[j].axis('off')
    fig.suptitle(sup_title, fontsize=13, fontweight='bold')
    legend_elems = [Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color=sig_color, lw=1.8, label='p < 0.05'),
                    Line2D([0], [0], marker='o', color=ns_color, lw=1.8, label='p ≥ 0.05')]
    fig.legend(handles=legend_elems, loc='lower center', ncol=2, fontsize=9, frameon=False)
    plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.98])
    plt.savefig(save_path, dpi=1200, bbox_inches='tight')
    plt.show()

plot_gee_forest(gee_mortality_results, all_categories,
                'Odds Ratio (log scale)',
                'Forest Plot — GEE Logistic Regression (In-Hospital Mortality): OR [95% CI] by Disease Category',
                '../data/output_files/endocrinas_parte2/forest_gee_or_mortality.png')
```

```{python}
# Table 10: Performance & Fit Metrics - GEE Logistic Models
gee_perf = []
for cat in all_categories:
    if cat not in gee_mortality_results:
        continue

    result = gee_mortality_results[cat]
    df_gee = gee_mortality_models[cat][1]
    df_cat = df_endocrinas[df_endocrinas['endocrine_category'] == cat]
    n_total = len(df_cat)
    n_events = df_cat['mortality'].sum()
    event_rate = n_events / n_total * 100 if n_total > 0 else 0

    try:
        y_pred_proba = result.fittedvalues
        y_actual = df_gee['mortality'].values

        auc_val = roc_auc_score(y_actual, y_pred_proba) if len(np.unique(y_actual)) > 1 else np.nan
        brier = brier_score_loss(y_actual, y_pred_proba)

        opt_threshold = find_optimal_threshold(y_actual, y_pred_proba)
        y_pred = (y_pred_proba >= opt_threshold).astype(int)

        accuracy = accuracy_score(y_actual, y_pred)
        sensitivity = recall_score(y_actual, y_pred, zero_division=0)
        specificity = recall_score(y_actual, y_pred, pos_label=0, zero_division=0)
        ppv = precision_score(y_actual, y_pred, zero_division=0)
        tn = ((1 - y_actual) * (1 - y_pred)).sum()
        fn = (y_actual * (1 - y_pred)).sum()
        npv = tn / (tn + fn) if (tn + fn) > 0 else 0
        f1 = f1_score(y_actual, y_pred, zero_division=0)
        mcc = matthews_corrcoef(y_actual, y_pred)
        youdens_j = sensitivity + specificity - 1

    except Exception:
        accuracy = sensitivity = specificity = ppv = npv = f1 = mcc = brier = auc_val = np.nan
        opt_threshold = np.nan
        youdens_j = np.nan

    n_sig_comorbs = len(sig_comorbidities_mortality.get(cat, []))
```

# 7. GEE Mixed-Effects Regression for Length of Stay (All Disease Categories)

```{python}
# Store GEE LOS model results
gee_los_models = {}
gee_los_results = {}

def build_gee_los_model(df_cat, cat_name):
    """Build GEE Negative Binomial regression for LOS.
    Uses hospital_id as cluster group, year_factor as fixed effect."""
    df_model = df_cat[df_cat['length_of_stay'] > 0].copy()

    service_dummies = pd.get_dummies(df_model['service_category'], prefix='service', drop_first=True)
    for col in service_dummies.columns:
        df_model[col] = service_dummies[col]
    service_dummy_cols = list(service_dummies.columns)

    year_dummies = pd.get_dummies(df_model['year_factor'], prefix='year', drop_first=True)
    for col in year_dummies.columns:
        df_model[col] = year_dummies[col]
    year_dummy_cols = list(year_dummies.columns)

    df_model['age'] = pd.to_numeric(df_model['age'], errors='coerce')

    predictor_cols = ['age', 'male'] + service_dummy_cols + year_dummy_cols

    for col in ['IR_29301_SEVERIDAD', 'IR_29301_MORTALIDAD']:
        if col in df_model.columns:
            df_model[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_model[col], errors='coerce')
            df_model[col] = df_model[col].fillna(1).clip(lower=1).astype(int)
            prefix = 'severity' if 'SEVERIDAD' in col else 'mort_risk'
            col_dummies = pd.get_dummies(df_model[col], prefix=prefix, drop_first=True)
            for dc in col_dummies.columns:
                df_model[dc] = col_dummies[dc]
                predictor_cols.append(dc)

    sig_comorbs = sig_comorbidities_los.get(cat_name, [])
    used_comorbs = []
    for col in sig_comorbs:
        if col in df_model.columns:
            df_model[col] = pd.to_numeric(df_model[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
            if df_model[col].sum() >= 3:
                predictor_cols.append(col)
                used_comorbs.append(col)

    df_model['_group'] = df_model['hospital_id']
    cols_for_model = ['length_of_stay', '_group'] + predictor_cols
    df_gee = df_model[cols_for_model].dropna()

    n_clusters = df_gee['_group'].nunique()
    if len(df_gee) < 50 or n_clusters < 2:
        return None, None, [], []

    y = df_gee['length_of_stay'].astype(float)
    X = df_gee[predictor_cols].astype(float)
    X = sm.add_constant(X)
    groups = df_gee['_group']

    try:
        gee_model = GEE(y, X, groups=groups, family=NegativeBinomial(alpha=1.0), cov_struct=Exchangeable())
        gee_result = gee_model.fit(maxiter=200)
    except Exception:
        try:
            gee_model = GEE(y, X, groups=groups, family=NegativeBinomial(alpha=1.0), cov_struct=Independence())
            gee_result = gee_model.fit(maxiter=200)
        except Exception:
            try:
                gee_model = GEE(y, X, groups=groups, family=Poisson(), cov_struct=Exchangeable())
                gee_result = gee_model.fit(maxiter=200)
            except Exception:
                return None, None, [], []

    max_retries = 5
    current_predictors = list(predictor_cols)
    for _ in range(max_retries):
        params = gee_result.params
        bad_vars = []
        for i, var in enumerate(current_predictors):
            idx = i + 1
            if idx < len(params) and (np.isinf(params.iloc[idx]) or abs(params.iloc[idx]) > 50):
                bad_vars.append(var)
        if not bad_vars:
            break
        current_predictors = [p for p in current_predictors if p not in bad_vars]
        if len(current_predictors) < 2:
            return None, None, [], []
        X = df_gee[current_predictors].astype(float)
        X = sm.add_constant(X)
        try:
            gee_model = GEE(y, X, groups=groups, family=NegativeBinomial(alpha=1.0), cov_struct=Exchangeable())
            gee_result = gee_model.fit(maxiter=200)
        except:
            try:
                gee_model = GEE(y, X, groups=groups, family=Poisson(), cov_struct=Exchangeable())
                gee_result = gee_model.fit(maxiter=200)
            except:
                return None, None, [], []

    return gee_result, df_gee, current_predictors, used_comorbs

# Fit GEE LOS models for EACH disease category
for cat in all_categories:
    df_cat = df_endocrinas[df_endocrinas['endocrine_category'] == cat].copy()
    if len(df_cat) < 50:
        continue
    gee_result, df_gee, used_cols, used_comorbs = build_gee_los_model(df_cat, cat)
    if gee_result is not None:
        gee_los_models[cat] = (gee_result, df_gee, used_cols)
        gee_los_results[cat] = gee_result

```

## 7.1 GEE Regression Results - IRR [95% CI]

```{python}
# Table 11: GEE Regression - IRR [95% CI] by Disease Category
gee_irr_table = {}

for cat in all_categories:
    if cat not in gee_los_results:
        continue

    result = gee_los_results[cat]
    used_cols = gee_los_models[cat][2]

    params = result.params
    conf = result.conf_int()
    pvalues = result.pvalues

    col_data = {}
    for i, var in enumerate(used_cols):
        idx = i + 1
        if idx >= len(params):
            continue
        coef = params.iloc[idx]
        if np.isinf(coef) or abs(coef) > 50:
            continue
        irr_val = np.exp(coef)
        ci_low = np.exp(conf.iloc[idx, 0])
        ci_high = np.exp(conf.iloc[idx, 1])
        pval = pvalues.iloc[idx]

        if np.isnan(irr_val) or np.isnan(pval):
            continue

        sig = '***' if pval < 0.001 else '**' if pval < 0.01 else '*' if pval < 0.05 else ''
        col_data[format_name(var)] = f'{irr_val:.3f} [{ci_low:.3f}, {ci_high:.3f}]{sig}'

    gee_irr_table[cat] = col_data

if gee_irr_table:
    all_vars = set()
    for col_data in gee_irr_table.values():
        all_vars.update(col_data.keys())

    irr_rows = []
    for var in sorted(all_vars):
        row = {'Variable': var}
        for cat in sorted(gee_irr_table.keys()):
            row[cat] = gee_irr_table[cat].get(var, '—')
        irr_rows.append(row)

    gee_irr_df = pd.DataFrame(irr_rows).set_index('Variable')
    show_table(gee_irr_df, "Table 11: GEE Mixed-Effects Regression - IRR [95% CI] for Length of Stay by Disease Category\n(Hospital as cluster, year as fixed effect, Negative Binomial family, only significant comorbidities)\n* p<0.05, ** p<0.01, *** p<0.001", index=True)
```

```{python}
# Table 12: Performance & Fit Metrics - GEE LOS Models
gee_los_perf = []
for cat in all_categories:
    if cat not in gee_los_results:
        continue

    result = gee_los_results[cat]
    df_gee = gee_los_models[cat][1]
    df_cat = df_endocrinas[df_endocrinas['endocrine_category'] == cat]
    n_total = len(df_cat)

    try:
        y_pred = result.fittedvalues
        y_actual = df_gee['length_of_stay'].values

        rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((y_actual - y_pred) ** 2))
        mae = np.mean(np.abs(y_actual - y_pred))
        ss_res = np.sum((y_actual - y_pred) ** 2)
        ss_tot = np.sum((y_actual - np.mean(y_actual)) ** 2)
        pseudo_r2 = 1 - ss_res / ss_tot if ss_tot > 0 else np.nan
    except Exception:
        rmse = mae = pseudo_r2 = np.nan

    n_sig_comorbs = len(sig_comorbidities_los.get(cat, []))
    fit_metrics = get_gee_fit_metrics(result, df_gee['length_of_stay'], family_type='count')

    gee_los_perf.append({
        'Disease Category': cat,
        'N obs': fit_metrics['N_obs'],
        'N clusters': fit_metrics['N_clusters'],
        'N params': fit_metrics['N_params'],
        'Mean LOS': f'{df_cat["length_of_stay"].mean():.1f}',
        'Median LOS': f'{df_cat["length_of_stay"].median():.0f}',
        'Sig. Comorb.': n_sig_comorbs,
        'Correlation': fit_metrics['Correlation'],
        'QIC': safe_fmt(fit_metrics['QIC'], '.1f'),
        'QICu': safe_fmt(fit_metrics['QICu'], '.1f'),
        'Pseudo R²': safe_fmt(fit_metrics['Pseudo R²']),
        'Scale': safe_fmt(fit_metrics['Scale']),
        'RMSE': f'{rmse:.2f}' if not np.isnan(rmse) else '—',
        'MAE': f'{mae:.2f}' if not np.isnan(mae) else '—',
    })

gee_los_perf_df = pd.DataFrame(gee_los_perf)
show_table(gee_los_perf_df, "Table 12: Performance & Fit Metrics - GEE Regression Models for LOS\n(QIC = Quasi-Information Criterion, Negative Binomial/Poisson family)", index=False)
```

# 8. Machine Learning Models for Mortality Prediction (Per Disease Category, Multiple Class Balancing)

```{python}
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier, GradientBoostingClassifier
from sklearn.svm import SVC
from sklearn.neural_network import MLPClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression as LR_sklearn
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import (
    roc_auc_score, roc_curve, confusion_matrix as cm_func,
    accuracy_score, f1_score, precision_score, recall_score,
    brier_score_loss, matthews_corrcoef
)

# Import multiple class balancing techniques
from collections import OrderedDict
try:
    from imblearn.over_sampling import SMOTE, ADASYN, RandomOverSampler
    from imblearn.under_sampling import RandomUnderSampler
    from imblearn.combine import SMOTETomek
    IMBLEARN_AVAILABLE = True
except ImportError:
    IMBLEARN_AVAILABLE = False

# Feature columns
ml_comorbidity_cols = [c for c in df_endocrinas.columns if c.startswith('comor_')]

ALL_BALANCING_NAMES = ['None (Original)', 'SMOTE', 'ADASYN', 'SMOTETomek',
                       'Random Oversampling', 'Random Undersampling']

def get_balancing_methods(y_train):
    """Return ALL class balancing methods, adapting k_neighbors to minority class size."""
    methods = OrderedDict()
    methods['None (Original)'] = None

    if not IMBLEARN_AVAILABLE:
        for name in ALL_BALANCING_NAMES[1:]:
            methods[name] = 'imblearn not installed'
        return methods

    n_minority = int(y_train.sum())
    k = min(5, n_minority - 1) if n_minority > 1 else 0

    if k >= 1:
        methods['SMOTE'] = SMOTE(random_state=42, k_neighbors=k)
        methods['ADASYN'] = ADASYN(random_state=42, n_neighbors=min(k, n_minority - 1))
        methods['SMOTETomek'] = SMOTETomek(random_state=42, smote=SMOTE(random_state=42, k_neighbors=k))
    else:
        methods['SMOTE'] = f'Insufficient minority samples (n={n_minority}, need k>=1)'
        methods['ADASYN'] = f'Insufficient minority samples (n={n_minority}, need k>=1)'
        methods['SMOTETomek'] = f'Insufficient minority samples (n={n_minority}, need k>=1)'
    methods['Random Oversampling'] = RandomOverSampler(random_state=42)
    methods['Random Undersampling'] = RandomUnderSampler(random_state=42)

    return methods

def _failed_balancing_entry(reason):
    """Return a placeholder result dict for a failed balancing technique."""
    return {
        'model': None, 'y_pred': None, 'y_proba': None, 'y_test': None,
        'opt_threshold': np.nan, 'cm': None, 'failed': True, 'fail_reason': reason,
        'metrics': {
            'AUC': np.nan, 'Bal. Accuracy': np.nan, 'Sensitivity': np.nan,
            'Specificity': np.nan, 'PPV': np.nan, 'NPV': np.nan,
            'F1': np.nan, 'MCC': np.nan, 'Brier': np.nan,
            "Youden's J": np.nan, 'Threshold': np.nan,
            'Train Size': '—', 'Minority %': '—'
        }
    }

def run_ml_mortality_multi_balancing(df_cat, cat_name):
    """Train ML classifiers with multiple class balancing techniques + optimal threshold"""
    df_ml = df_cat.copy()
    df_ml['age'] = pd.to_numeric(df_ml['age'], errors='coerce')

    svc_dummies = pd.get_dummies(df_ml['service_category'], prefix='service', drop_first=True)
    for c in svc_dummies.columns:
        df_ml[c] = svc_dummies[c]

    feature_names = ['age', 'male'] + list(svc_dummies.columns) + ml_comorbidity_cols
    target = 'mortality'

    df_ml = df_ml[feature_names + [target]].dropna()

    n_pos = int(df_ml[target].sum())
    n_neg = int((df_ml[target] == 0).sum())

    if len(df_ml) < 30 or n_pos < 5 or n_neg < 5:
        return None, None, None

    X = df_ml[feature_names].values
    y = df_ml[target].values

    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)

    try:
        X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
            X_scaled, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y
        )
    except ValueError:
        X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
            X_scaled, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
        )

    balancing_methods = get_balancing_methods(y_train)

    base_model_class = GradientBoostingClassifier
    base_model_params = {'n_estimators': 150, 'random_state': 42, 'max_depth': 4}

    balancing_results = OrderedDict()

    for bal_name, balancer in balancing_methods.items():
        if isinstance(balancer, str):
            balancing_results[bal_name] = _failed_balancing_entry(balancer)
            continue

        try:
            if balancer is not None:
                X_res, y_res = balancer.fit_resample(X_train, y_train)
            else:
                X_res, y_res = X_train, y_train

            model = base_model_class(**base_model_params)
            model.fit(X_res, y_res)
            y_proba = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

            fpr_t, tpr_t, thresholds_t = roc_curve(y_test, y_proba)
            j_scores = tpr_t - fpr_t
            best_idx = np.argmax(j_scores)
            opt_threshold = thresholds_t[best_idx]
            y_pred = (y_proba >= opt_threshold).astype(int)

            tn, fp, fn, tp = cm_func(y_test, y_pred).ravel()
            sens = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) > 0 else 0
            spec = tn / (tn + fp) if (tn + fp) > 0 else 0
            ppv_val = tp / (tp + fp) if (tp + fp) > 0 else 0
            npv_val = tn / (tn + fn) if (tn + fn) > 0 else 0

            balancing_results[bal_name] = {
                'model': model, 'y_pred': y_pred, 'y_proba': y_proba,
                'y_test': y_test, 'opt_threshold': opt_threshold,
                'cm': cm_func(y_test, y_pred), 'failed': False,
                'metrics': {
                    'AUC': roc_auc_score(y_test, y_proba) if len(np.unique(y_test)) > 1 else 0,
                    'Bal. Accuracy': (sens + spec) / 2,
                    'Sensitivity': sens, 'Specificity': spec,
                    'PPV': ppv_val, 'NPV': npv_val,
                    'F1': f1_score(y_test, y_pred, zero_division=0),
                    'MCC': matthews_corrcoef(y_test, y_pred),
                    'Brier': brier_score_loss(y_test, y_proba),
                    "Youden's J": sens + spec - 1,
                    'Threshold': opt_threshold,
                    'Train Size': len(y_res),
                    'Minority %': f'{y_res.sum()/len(y_res)*100:.1f}'
                }
            }
        except Exception as e:
            balancing_results[bal_name] = _failed_balancing_entry(str(e))

    # Run multiple model types with the BEST balancing technique
    successful_results = {k: v for k, v in balancing_results.items() if not v.get('failed', False)}
    if not successful_results:
        return balancing_results, None, None

    best_balancing = max(successful_results, key=lambda k: successful_results[k]['metrics']['AUC'])
    best_balancer = balancing_methods.get(best_balancing)

    if best_balancer is not None:
        try:
            X_best, y_best = best_balancer.fit_resample(X_train, y_train)
        except:
            X_best, y_best = X_train, y_train
    else:
        X_best, y_best = X_train, y_train

    all_models = {
        'Logistic Regression': LR_sklearn(max_iter=1000, random_state=42, class_weight='balanced'),
        'Random Forest': RandomForestClassifier(n_estimators=200, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1, class_weight='balanced'),
        'Gradient Boosting': GradientBoostingClassifier(n_estimators=150, random_state=42, max_depth=4),
        'SVM': SVC(kernel='rbf', probability=True, random_state=42, class_weight='balanced'),
        'MLP': MLPClassifier(hidden_layer_sizes=(64, 32), max_iter=1000, random_state=42)
    }

    model_results = {}
    for name, model in all_models.items():
        try:
            model.fit(X_best, y_best)
            y_proba = model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

            fpr_t, tpr_t, thresholds_t = roc_curve(y_test, y_proba)
            j_scores = tpr_t - fpr_t
            best_idx = np.argmax(j_scores)
            opt_threshold = thresholds_t[best_idx]
            y_pred = (y_proba >= opt_threshold).astype(int)

            tn, fp, fn, tp = cm_func(y_test, y_pred).ravel()
            sens = tp / (tp + fn) if (tp + fn) > 0 else 0
            spec = tn / (tn + fp) if (tn + fp) > 0 else 0
            ppv_val = tp / (tp + fp) if (tp + fp) > 0 else 0
            npv_val = tn / (tn + fn) if (tn + fn) > 0 else 0

            model_results[name] = {
                'model': model, 'y_pred': y_pred, 'y_proba': y_proba,
                'y_test': y_test, 'opt_threshold': opt_threshold,
                'cm': cm_func(y_test, y_pred),
                'metrics': {
                    'AUC': roc_auc_score(y_test, y_proba) if len(np.unique(y_test)) > 1 else 0,
                    'Bal. Accuracy': (sens + spec) / 2,
                    'Sensitivity': sens, 'Specificity': spec,
                    'PPV': ppv_val, 'NPV': npv_val,
                    'F1': f1_score(y_test, y_pred, zero_division=0),
                    'MCC': matthews_corrcoef(y_test, y_pred),
                    'Brier': brier_score_loss(y_test, y_proba),
                    "Youden's J": sens + spec - 1,
                    'Threshold': opt_threshold
                }
            }
        except:
            pass

    return balancing_results, model_results, (feature_names, X_test, y_test, best_balancing)

# Run ML mortality models for EACH disease category
ml_balancing_by_cat = {}
ml_models_by_cat = {}
ml_meta_by_cat = {}

for cat in all_categories:
    df_cat = df_endocrinas[df_endocrinas['endocrine_category'] == cat].copy()
    bal_results, model_results, meta = run_ml_mortality_multi_balancing(df_cat, cat)
    if bal_results is not None and len(bal_results) > 0:
        ml_balancing_by_cat[cat] = bal_results
        if model_results is not None:
            ml_models_by_cat[cat] = model_results
        if meta is not None:
            ml_meta_by_cat[cat] = meta
```

# 9. Machine Learning Models for Length of Stay Prediction (Per Disease Category)

```{python}
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestRegressor, GradientBoostingRegressor
from sklearn.linear_model import LinearRegression, Ridge, Lasso
from sklearn.metrics import mean_squared_error, mean_absolute_error, r2_score

def run_ml_los_for_cat(df_cat, cat_name):
    """Train 5 ML regressors for LOS on a single disease category"""
    df_ml = df_cat[df_cat['length_of_stay'] > 0].copy()
    df_ml['age'] = pd.to_numeric(df_ml['age'], errors='coerce')

    svc_dummies = pd.get_dummies(df_ml['service_category'], prefix='service', drop_first=True)
    for c in svc_dummies.columns:
        df_ml[c] = svc_dummies[c]

    feature_names = ['age', 'male'] + list(svc_dummies.columns) + ml_comorbidity_cols
    target = 'length_of_stay'

    df_ml = df_ml[feature_names + [target]].dropna()

    if len(df_ml) < 80:
        return None, None

    X = df_ml[feature_names].values
    y = df_ml[target].values

    scaler = StandardScaler()
    X_scaled = scaler.fit_transform(X)

    X_train, X_test, y_train, y_test = train_test_split(
        X_scaled, y, test_size=0.2, random_state=42
    )

    models = {
        'Linear Regression': LinearRegression(),
        'Ridge': Ridge(alpha=1.0),
        'Lasso': Lasso(alpha=0.1, max_iter=5000),
        'Random Forest': RandomForestRegressor(n_estimators=100, random_state=42, n_jobs=-1),
        'Gradient Boosting': GradientBoostingRegressor(n_estimators=100, random_state=42)
    }

    results = {}
    for name, model in models.items():
        try:
            model.fit(X_train, y_train)
            y_pred = model.predict(X_test)

            results[name] = {
                'model': model, 'y_pred': y_pred, 'y_test': y_test,
                'metrics': {
                    'RMSE': np.sqrt(mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred)),
                    'MAE': mean_absolute_error(y_test, y_pred),
                    'R2': r2_score(y_test, y_pred),
                    'MSE': mean_squared_error(y_test, y_pred)
                }
            }
        except:
            pass

    return results, feature_names

# Run ML LOS models for EACH disease category
ml_los_by_cat = {}
ml_los_features_by_cat = {}

for cat in all_categories:
    df_cat = df_endocrinas[df_endocrinas['endocrine_category'] == cat].copy()
    results, feat_names = run_ml_los_for_cat(df_cat, cat)
    if results and len(results) > 0:
        ml_los_by_cat[cat] = results
        ml_los_features_by_cat[cat] = feat_names
```

```{python}
# Combined summary: best model per category for mortality and LOS
summary_rows = []
for cat in all_categories:

    row['N'] = f'{len(df_cat):,}'

    row['Mean LOS'] = f'{df_cat["length_of_stay"].mean():.1f}'

    # GEE Logistic regression AUC
    if cat in gee_mortality_results:
        try:
            result = gee_mortality_results[cat]
            df_gee = gee_mortality_models[cat][1]
            y_proba = result.fittedvalues
            y_actual = df_gee['mortality'].values
            row['GEE Mortality AUC'] = f'{roc_auc_score(y_actual, y_proba):.3f}'
        except:
            row['GEE Mortality AUC'] = '—'
    else:
        row['GEE Mortality AUC'] = '—'

    # Best ML mortality AUC
    if cat in ml_models_by_cat and ml_models_by_cat[cat]:
        best_name = max(ml_models_by_cat[cat], key=lambda k: ml_models_by_cat[cat][k]['metrics']['AUC'])
        best_auc = ml_models_by_cat[cat][best_name]['metrics']['AUC']
        best_balancing = ml_meta_by_cat[cat][3] if ml_meta_by_cat.get(cat) else 'Unknown'
        row['Best ML Mortality AUC'] = f'{best_auc:.3f} ({best_name}, {best_balancing})'
    else:
        row['Best ML Mortality AUC'] = '—'

    # GEE LOS RMSE
    if cat in gee_los_results:
        try:
            result = gee_los_results[cat]
            df_gee = gee_los_models[cat][1]
            y_pred = result.fittedvalues
            y_actual = df_gee['length_of_stay'].values
            rmse = np.sqrt(np.mean((y_actual - y_pred) ** 2))
            row['GEE LOS RMSE'] = f'{rmse:.2f}'
        except:
            row['GEE LOS RMSE'] = '—'
    else:
        row['GEE LOS RMSE'] = '—'

    # Best ML LOS R²
    if cat in ml_los_by_cat:
        best_name = max(ml_los_by_cat[cat], key=lambda k: ml_los_by_cat[cat][k]['metrics']['R2'])
        best_r2 = ml_los_by_cat[cat][best_name]['metrics']['R2']
        row['Best ML R² (LOS)'] = f'{best_r2:.3f} ({best_name})'
    else:
        row['Best ML R² (LOS)'] = '—'

    summary_rows.append(row)

summary_df = pd.DataFrame(summary_rows)
```

# 11. Discussion

## 11.1 Key Findings

This analysis of endocrine, nutritional and metabolic diseases in Chile (2019-2024) provides independent regression and machine learning models for each disease category, enabling category-specific risk assessment for both in-hospital mortality and length of stay.

## 11.2 Regression Model Approach

Mixed-effects models were fit using Generalized Estimating Equations (GEE) to account for the hierarchical structure of observations within hospitals and years. For mortality, GEE logistic regression was used with Binomial family and exchangeable correlation structure. For length of stay, GEE negative binomial regression was used to account for overdispersion in count data, with Poisson as fallback. All models include age, sex, service category, severity/mortality indices, and only significant comorbidities from bivariate analysis (p < 0.05), improving parsimony and interpretability. Hospital was specified as the grouping variable to capture clustering effects.

## 11.3 Machine Learning Approach

To address class imbalance and improve generalization, multiple class balancing techniques were evaluated: SMOTE, ADASYN, SMOTETomek, random oversampling, random undersampling, and no balancing (original). For each disease category, gradient boosting was used as the base model to identify the best-performing balancing method by AUC. Subsequently, five classifiers (Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, SVM, MLP) were trained using the optimal balancing strategy. All models used optimal decision thresholds derived from Youden's J statistic rather than default 0.5 cutoff, improving balanced accuracy and clinical utility.

---

# 12. Conclusion

This analysis provides a comprehensive epidemiological profile of endocrine, nutritional and metabolic diseases in Chilean public hospitals. The results highlight the importance of comorbidity screening, the differential impact of lifestyle-related factors by disease category, and temporal patterns that may inform resource allocation and clinical practice.

---

**Analysis of endocrine, nutritional and metabolic diseases in Chile using GRD public hospital discharge records (2019-2024). This document provides a comprehensive statistical analysis following mixed-effects modeling methodology with machine learning validation.**

```{python}
    ax.axvline(0.5, color='black', ls='--', lw=1.0, alpha=0.6, label='No skill')
    for yi, a in enumerate(aucs_b):
        ax.text(a + 0.005, yi, f'{a:.3f}', va='center', fontsize=6.5)
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(cats_b)))
    ax.set_yticklabels([_short_cat_m(c) for c in cats_b], fontsize=8)
    ax.set_xlim(0.45, 1.02)
    ax.set_xlabel('AUC (mortality discrimination)', fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title('GEE logistic AUC by category', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
    ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc='lower right', frameon=False)
    sns.despine(ax=ax)
    ax.grid(True, axis='x', alpha=0.3)
except Exception as e:
    ax.axis('off'); ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'panel unavailable', ha='center', va='center',
                            fontsize=8, transform=ax.transAxes)

# ---- Panel C: ROC overlay of GEE mortality models ----
ax = axes[2]
try:
    cats_c = [c for c in all_categories if c in gee_mortality_results]
    cmap_c = plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0, 0.9, max(len(cats_c), 1)))
    plotted = 0
    for i, c in enumerate(cats_c):
        try:
            res = gee_mortality_results[c]
            df_g = gee_mortality_models[c][1]
            y_true = df_g['mortality'].values
            y_sc = np.asarray(res.fittedvalues, dtype=float)
            if len(np.unique(y_true)) < 2:
                continue
            fpr, tpr, _ = roc_curve(y_true, y_sc)
            a = roc_auc_score(y_true, y_sc)
            ax.plot(fpr, tpr, lw=1.6, color=cmap_c[i],
                    label=f'{_short_cat_m(c)} ({a:.2f})')
            plotted += 1
        except Exception:
            continue
    ax.plot([0, 1], [0, 1], 'k--', lw=1.0, alpha=0.6)
    ax.set_xlabel('False-positive rate', fontsize=9)
    ax.set_ylabel('True-positive rate', fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title('GEE mortality ROC curves', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
    if plotted:
        ax.legend(fontsize=6, loc='lower right', frameon=False, ncol=1)
    sns.despine(ax=ax)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
except Exception as e:
    ax.axis('off'); ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'panel unavailable', ha='center', va='center',
                            fontsize=8, transform=ax.transAxes)

# ---- Panel D: strongest mortality OR predictors (forest) ----
ax = axes[3]
try:
    or_rows = []
    for c in all_categories:
        cell_map = gee_or_table.get(c, {})
        for var, cell in cell_map.items():
            est, lo, hi = _parse_ci_m(cell)
            if not (np.isfinite(est) and np.isfinite(lo) and np.isfinite(hi)):
                continue
            if est <= 0 or est > 50:
                continue
            # strength = distance from OR = 1 on log scale, require finite CI
            or_rows.append((f'{_short_cat_m(c)} · {var}', est, lo, hi,
                            abs(np.log(est))))
    if not or_rows:
        raise ValueError('no OR predictors')
    or_rows.sort(key=lambda r: r[4])
    or_rows = or_rows[-12:]  # 12 strongest
    labels_d = [r[0] for r in or_rows]
    ests_d = np.array([r[1] for r in or_rows])
    los_d = np.array([r[2] for r in or_rows])
    his_d = np.array([r[3] for r in or_rows])
    for yi, (e, lo, hi) in enumerate(zip(ests_d, los_d, his_d)):
        col = '#D55E00' if e > 1 else '#0072B2'
        ax.plot([lo, hi], [yi, yi], color=col, lw=1.7, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=2)
        ax.plot([e], [yi], 'o', color=col, ms=5, zorder=3)
    ax.axvline(1.0, color='black', ls='--', lw=1.0, alpha=0.7, zorder=1)
    ax.set_xscale('log')
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(labels_d)))
    ax.set_yticklabels(labels_d, fontsize=6)
    ax.set_ylim(-0.6, len(labels_d) - 0.4)
    ax.set_xlabel('Odds ratio (log scale)', fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title('Strongest mortality OR predictors', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
    sns.despine(ax=ax)
    ax.grid(True, axis='x', alpha=0.3)
except Exception as e:
    ax.axis('off'); ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'panel unavailable', ha='center', va='center',
                            fontsize=8, transform=ax.transAxes)

# ---- Panel E: best ML mortality AUC per category ----
ax = axes[4]
try:
    rows_e = []
    for c in all_categories:
        res = ml_models_by_cat.get(c)
        if not res:
            continue
        best_name = max(res, key=lambda k: res[k]['metrics']['AUC'])
        best_auc = res[best_name]['metrics']['AUC']
        if not np.isfinite(best_auc):
            continue
        rows_e.append((c, best_auc, best_name))
    if not rows_e:
        raise ValueError('no ML AUCs')
    rows_e.sort(key=lambda r: r[1])
    cats_e = [r[0] for r in rows_e]
    aucs_e = [r[1] for r in rows_e]
    x = np.arange(len(cats_e))
    cmap_e = plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0.1, 0.85, len(cats_e)))
    ax.bar(x, aucs_e, color=cmap_e, alpha=0.95)
    ax.axhline(0.5, color='black', ls='--', lw=1.0, alpha=0.6, label='No skill')
    for xi, a in enumerate(aucs_e):
        ax.text(xi, a + 0.01, f'{a:.3f}', ha='center', va='bottom', fontsize=6.5)
    ax.set_xticks(x)
    ax.set_xticklabels([_short_cat_m(c) for c in cats_e], rotation=45, ha='right', fontsize=7)
    ax.set_ylim(0.45, 1.05)
    ax.set_ylabel('AUC (best ML classifier)', fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title('Best machine-learning mortality AUC by category', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
    ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc='lower right', frameon=False)
    sns.despine(ax=ax)
    ax.grid(True, axis='y', alpha=0.3)
except Exception as e:
    ax.axis('off'); ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'panel unavailable', ha='center', va='center',
                            fontsize=8, transform=ax.transAxes)

fig.suptitle('Endocrine-metabolic hospitalizations in Chile (GRD 2019-2024): '
             'mortality burden, model discrimination and key predictors',
             fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', y=0.975)

import os as _os
_os.makedirs('../data/output_files/endocrinas_parte2', exist_ok=True)
plt.savefig('../data/output_files/endocrinas_parte2/composite_mortality.png',
            dpi=1200, bbox_inches='tight', facecolor='white')
plt.show()
```

# Composite Figure — Length of Stay and Comorbidity Burden

```{python}
#| label: fig-composite-los
#| fig-cap: "Composite length-of-stay and comorbidity summary across endocrine-metabolic disease categories (GRD 2019-2024). (A) Mean length of stay (days) by disease category; (B) GEE Negative-Binomial incidence-rate ratios for length of stay per category (forest plot, log scale, reference IRR = 1); (C) length-of-stay impact heatmap (mean days with minus without each comorbidity, by category); (D) comorbidity prevalence across the cohort (%); (E) temporal trends in overall in-hospital mortality and mean length of stay, 2019-2024."
#| fig-width: 11
#| fig-height: 13

import re as _re2

_okabe_l = ['#E69F00', '#56B4E9', '#009E73', '#F0E442', '#0072B2', '#D55E00', '#CC79A7', '#000000']

def _short_cat_l(c):
    """Drop the 'Exx-Exx: ' code prefix for compact axis labels."""
    s = str(c)
    return s.split(':', 1)[1].strip() if ':' in s else s

def _parse_lead_l(txt):
    m = _re2.match(r'\s*([0-9]*\.?[0-9]+)', str(txt))
    return float(m.group(1)) if m else np.nan

def _parse_ci_l(txt):
    est = _parse_lead_l(txt)
    m = _re2.search(r'\[\s*([0-9]*\.?[0-9]+)\s*,\s*([0-9]*\.?[0-9]+)\s*\]', str(txt))
    if m:
        return est, float(m.group(1)), float(m.group(2))
    return est, np.nan, np.nan

panel_labels_l = ['A', 'B', 'C', 'D', 'E']
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(11, 13))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 2, hspace=0.58, wspace=0.34,
                      left=0.10, right=0.97, top=0.93, bottom=0.07)
axes = [fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0]), fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1]),
        fig.add_subplot(gs[1, :]),
        fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0]), fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])]
for ax, lab in zip(axes, panel_labels_l):
    ax.text(-0.08, 1.06, lab, transform=ax.transAxes, fontsize=13,
            fontweight='bold', va='top')

# ---- Panel A: mean LOS by disease category ----
ax = axes[0]
try:
    los = df_endocrinas.groupby('endocrine_category')['length_of_stay'].mean()
    los = los.dropna().sort_values(ascending=True)
    overall_los = df_endocrinas['length_of_stay'].mean()
    cmap_a = plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0.1, 0.85, len(los)))
    ax.barh(range(len(los)), los.values, color=cmap_a, alpha=0.95)
    ax.axvline(overall_los, color='black', ls='--', lw=1.0, alpha=0.7,
               label=f'Overall {overall_los:.1f} d')
    for yi, v in enumerate(los.values):
        ax.text(v + 0.1, yi, f'{v:.1f}', va='center', fontsize=6.5)
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(los)))
    ax.set_yticklabels([_short_cat_l(c) for c in los.index], fontsize=8)
    ax.set_xlabel('Mean length of stay (days)', fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title('Length of stay by category', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
    ax.legend(fontsize=7, loc='lower right', frameon=False)
    sns.despine(ax=ax)
    ax.grid(True, axis='x', alpha=0.3)
except Exception as e:
    ax.axis('off'); ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'panel unavailable', ha='center', va='center',
                            fontsize=8, transform=ax.transAxes)

# ---- Panel B: GEE Negative-Binomial IRR by category (forest) ----
ax = axes[1]
try:
    irr_rows = []
    for c in all_categories:
        cell_map = gee_irr_table.get(c, {})
        for var, cell in cell_map.items():
            est, lo, hi = _parse_ci_l(cell)
            if not (np.isfinite(est) and np.isfinite(lo) and np.isfinite(hi)):
                continue
            if est <= 0 or est > 50:
                continue
            irr_rows.append((f'{_short_cat_l(c)} · {var}', est, lo, hi, abs(np.log(est))))
    if not irr_rows:
        raise ValueError('no IRR predictors')
    irr_rows.sort(key=lambda r: r[4])
    irr_rows = irr_rows[-12:]  # 12 strongest
    labels_b = [r[0] for r in irr_rows]
    ests_b = np.array([r[1] for r in irr_rows])
    los_b = np.array([r[2] for r in irr_rows])
    his_b = np.array([r[3] for r in irr_rows])
    for yi, (e, lo, hi) in enumerate(zip(ests_b, los_b, his_b)):
        col = '#D55E00' if e > 1 else '#0072B2'
        ax.plot([lo, hi], [yi, yi], color=col, lw=1.7, solid_capstyle='round', zorder=2)
        ax.plot([e], [yi], 'o', color=col, ms=5, zorder=3)
    ax.axvline(1.0, color='black', ls='--', lw=1.0, alpha=0.7, zorder=1)
    ax.set_xscale('log')
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(labels_b)))
    ax.set_yticklabels(labels_b, fontsize=6)
    ax.set_ylim(-0.6, len(labels_b) - 0.4)
    ax.set_xlabel('Incidence rate ratio (log scale)', fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title('Strongest GEE NB length-of-stay IRR', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
    sns.despine(ax=ax)
    ax.grid(True, axis='x', alpha=0.3)
except Exception as e:
    ax.axis('off'); ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'panel unavailable', ha='center', va='center',
                            fontsize=8, transform=ax.transAxes)

# ---- Panel C: LOS-impact comorbidity heatmap ----
ax = axes[2]
try:
    hm = heatmap_los_impact_df.copy()
    hm.index = [_short_cat_l(c) for c in hm.index]
    vmax = float(np.nanmax(np.abs(hm.values))) if hm.size else 1.0
    vmax = vmax if np.isfinite(vmax) and vmax > 0 else 1.0
    sns.heatmap(hm, ax=ax, cmap='RdBu_r', center=0, vmin=-vmax, vmax=vmax,
                cbar_kws={'label': 'LOS difference (days)', 'shrink': 0.7},
                linewidths=0.3, linecolor='white')

    plt.setp(ax.get_yticklabels(), rotation=0, fontsize=7)
except Exception as e:
    ax.axis('off'); ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'panel unavailable', ha='center', va='center',
                            fontsize=8, transform=ax.transAxes)

# ---- Panel D: comorbidity prevalence across cohort ----
ax = axes[3]
try:
    prev = comor_pct.copy()
    prev.index = [format_name('comor_' + str(i)) for i in prev.index]
    prev = prev.sort_values(ascending=True)
    cmap_d = plt.cm.viridis(np.linspace(0.1, 0.85, len(prev)))
    ax.barh(range(len(prev)), prev.values, color=cmap_d, alpha=0.95)
    for yi, v in enumerate(prev.values):
        ax.text(v + 0.2, yi, f'{v:.1f}', va='center', fontsize=6)
    ax.set_yticks(range(len(prev)))
    ax.set_yticklabels(prev.index, fontsize=6.5)
    ax.set_xlabel('Prevalence (% of cohort)', fontsize=9)
    ax.set_title('Comorbidity prevalence', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')

    ax.grid(True, axis='x', alpha=0.3)
except Exception as e:
    ax.axis('off'); ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'panel unavailable', ha='center', va='center',
                            fontsize=8, transform=ax.transAxes)

# ---- Panel E: temporal mortality and LOS trends ----
ax = axes[4]
try:
    mort_yr = df_endocrinas.groupby('year')['mortality'].mean() * 100
    los_yr = df_endocrinas.groupby('year')['length_of_stay'].mean()
    yrs = mort_yr.index.values
    ln1 = ax.plot(yrs, mort_yr.values, marker='o', lw=2.2, ms=7,
                  color='#D55E00', label='Mortality (%)')
    ax.set_xlabel('Year', fontsize=9)
    ax.set_ylabel('In-hospital mortality (%)', fontsize=9, color='#D55E00')
    ax.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#D55E00')
    ax2 = ax.twinx()
    ln2 = ax2.plot(yrs, los_yr.values, marker='s', lw=2.2, ms=7,
                   color='#0072B2', label='Mean LOS (days)')
    ax2.set_ylabel('Mean length of stay (days)', fontsize=9, color='#0072B2')
    ax2.tick_params(axis='y', labelcolor='#0072B2')
    ax.set_title('Temporal trends, 2019-2024', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
    lns = ln1 + ln2
    ax.legend(lns, [l.get_label() for l in lns], fontsize=7, loc='best', frameon=False)
    ax.set_xticks(yrs)
    ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
    sns.despine(ax=ax, right=False)
except Exception as e:
    ax.axis('off'); ax.text(0.5, 0.5, 'panel unavailable', ha='center', va='center',
                            fontsize=8, transform=ax.transAxes)

fig.suptitle('Endocrine-metabolic hospitalizations in Chile (GRD 2019-2024): '
             'length of stay, comorbidity burden and temporal trends',
             fontsize=13, fontweight='bold', y=0.975)
```
